name: box
title: Box
description: A div with padding and a thin border mapped to the spacing tokens.
a11y: A plain element; adds no roles. Use asChild to render a landmark such as section.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding on all sides: a step on the spacing scale (1 = --s1 up to 9).

props.name: paddingX
props.description: Horizontal padding (left and right) as a step 1 to 9 on the spacing scale; overrides `padding` on that axis.

props.name: paddingY
props.description: Vertical padding (top and bottom) as a step 1 to 9 on the spacing scale; overrides `padding` on that axis.

props.name: border
props.description: A thin rule on every side (`true`) or on one side.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child (a `section`, `aside`, `li`) with the box styles.

usage:
import {Box} from '@monoline/react';

<Box padding={5} border>A bordered box with step 5 padding.</Box>
